description: FilmCraft: An open-source, nonlinear video editor written by scratch in pure Rust

latest_release.name: FilmCraft v0.18.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* web: check MP4 sample extent before allocating its buffer by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4102
* avi: hold child chunks to their container so lists cannot overlap by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4106
* security(dnx): cap decoded frame memory and reject repeated scan line indices by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4101
* security(apv): size the auxiliary alpha frame only after its tiles decode by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4109
* web: load only a same-origin http(s) app in the WebCodecs read-error harness by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4103
* captions: escape a TTML cue's unclosed '<' tail in one pass by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4105
* interchange: AAF top-level composition carries the registered Usage_TopLevel (#3986) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3987
* Interchange export: saturate timecodes and PCM fields on hostile project values by @Lightningbulb2 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4029
* interchange: EDL clips named only by clip name are missing, not made offline (#3997) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4000
* interchange: EDL media relinked with Align Timecode lands on the file's own time (#3990) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3996
* interchange: an OTIO item at a sample rate no longer sets the sequence rate (#4111) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4112
* interchange: EDL and OMF export reports name the video tracks they leave out (#4132) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4133
* engine: AAF/OMF export takes bitDepth as "24" too, and refuses anything but 16 or 24 (#4019) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4020
* captions: TTML export writes the track language, import keeps it (#4025) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4038
* Reject '+'-signed audio channel numbers in EDL import by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3935
* Only decode percent escapes made of hex digits in file URLs by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3936
* Strip leading BOM in WebVTT parse even without a signature by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3961
* Read TTS fractions with denominator 1 as "over one" by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3983
* Fix per-character Stroke and Stroke 2 appearance controls by @wweimao in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3938
* captions: SCC and MCC export name the characters they drop or replace (#4023) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4036
* i18n(ru): translate the 64 strings the missing-translations report listed (#1674) by @rahul05ranjan in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3960
* i18n(zh-cn): translate the 41 strings the report listed as missing by @rahul05ranjan in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3964
* codecs: an MP4 edit rounded to the movie timescale keeps the last frame by @Agapenordev in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3994
* lumetri.presetThumbnails: write through the host and keep the grid to the presets by @Lightningbulb2 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4030
* Name Apple Intermediate Codec and show why a clip is unreadable (part of #3646) by @scks1 in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4010
* cli: a missing project stops a save in place before it opens by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/3946
* Import by a relative path: '..' climbs out of the document folder, and media paths are resolved once (#3998, #4001) by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/pull/4004
* essentialSound.set: ducking.against takes the type names setType takes by @JonRC in https://github.com/storytold/filmcraft/p

detail.readme_excerpt:
FilmCraft

Video editing, color and sound; an open-source, professional non-linear video editor, built in pure Rust.

An open-source, modern non-linear video editing workflow: native on macOS, Windows and Linux, and in the browser via WebAssembly.
By the ArtCraft team.
